solutions.title: Used-position scan
solutions.strategy: For each needed character, scan the supply for one unused matching position.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each of r target characters can scan up to m supply characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A boolean array tracks which supply positions have been consumed.

solutions.title: Frequency count
solutions.strategy: Count available characters and decrement counts for the target.

timeComplexity.explanation: The supply and target are each scanned once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The map stores counts for each distinct supplied character.
